{{Quote|Make your way to the awors backstage.|Trebla|<ref name="The Curse of the Jindas">{{Ewoks|The Curse of the Jindas}}</ref>}}
'''Awors''' were large [[Color/Legends|gray]] animals that were used by the [[Travelling Jindas]]. During the [[Jinda/Legends|Jindas']] early days with the [[Rock Wizard]], the animals were used to till the soil, helping the Jindas farm the area. Following the Jindas' exile, the awors were still used, but only to carry the Jindas' materials. The large beasts carried the Jindas' entertainment equipment and helped them set up their entertainment shows.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Aworjindasketch.jpg|thumb|left|The awor's name is listed on this animation thumbnail sketch by the Nelvana animation studio.]]
The creatures are labeled "AWOR" on artwork used in the animation process for the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] cartoon series.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://ewokcels.com/collectibles.htm|text="Other Stuff: Non-Ewok Cartoon items you might want to see"|author=Maureen Kuppe|work=EwokCels.com|archiveurl=https://archive.is/pdEqR}}</ref>
